summary: The focused and full suites passed (298 tests), and the presentation changes appear to preserve the character-creation form contract. However, multiple files under automation_v2 were changed outside the explicitly allowed areas. The guardrail report lists only four changed files and incorrectly reports no violations, while the supplied diff and changed-files list include automation_v2 reports, state, and run artifacts. Additionally, automation/AGENT_REPORT.md says tests were not executed and results were unavailable, conflicting with the provided successful test results and failing the reporting acceptance criterion.
repair_instructions: Revert or exclude all task-authored changes under automation_v2, including automation_v2/AGENT_REPORT.md and automation_v2/state.json; retain run artifacts only if they are generated and managed externally rather than part of the implementation change.
Update automation/AGENT_REPORT.md to record the actual focused and full test commands and successful results, including the full-suite result of 298 passed with 10 warnings.
Regenerate or correct the guardrail assessment so its changed-files list matches the actual implementation diff and flags any remaining files outside the allowed areas.
Re-run the focused and full test suites after cleaning the scope and confirm both still pass.
risks: Out-of-scope automation state and report changes could affect orchestration behavior or leave misleading repository state.
The current completion report contradicts the authoritative test results, making the audit trail unreliable.
The discrepancy between guardrail output and the actual changed-files list may conceal additional scope violations.
